checks.invariant: Every INI value accepted by Config::parse stays in a range that cannot panic or mis-index downstream
checks.result: Strict ranges (flags 0/1, NumDays 0..=11, Introduction 0..=12, Year<=9999, Month<=12, Day<=31, StartTime<=2359 with minutes<60); bad value or non key=value line returns None; half_hour_slot inputs non-negative; island.init clamps max_day; year/month/day only compared with the clock.

checks.invariant: INI path is fixed and odd file types cause no cross-principal effect
checks.result: Path is settings_dir()/SCRANTIC.INI, constant name; non-UTF-8/directory/unreadable falls back to defaults; unbounded read_to_string and symlink-following fs::write matter only for a writer of the install dir, who can already replace data files and the executable.

checks.invariant: Data and settings read only from fixed directories, no CWD or value-controlled search path
checks.result: app_dir from current_exe parent; user dir from APPDATA of the same user; fixed list; no CWD-relative search.

checks.invariant: Files written by the process cannot be redirected by a lower-trust principal
checks.result: Screenshot (F12 only) and INI writes use fs::write following symlinks with a predictable name; exploitable only in an install directory writable by another user, which already allows replacing the executable; standard per-user and admin installs are not.

checks.invariant: Args/env cannot inject paths or commands
checks.result: Only OUT_DIR and a numeric step name form the output path; no process spawned; SIZE=0xN panics in png() and huge SIZE allocates (developer tool, not shipped, self-inflicted).

checks.invariant: scale/dedither/plain/png do not index out of range for sizes the shipped binary passes
checks.result: Zero-size handled early, windows via NonZeroU32, frame always 640x480.

hardening: Use OpenOptions::create_new for screenshots and refuse a symlinked SCRANTIC.INI if the app may run from a directory writable by others; write the INI via temp file + atomic rename.
Cap the SCRANTIC.INI read (e.g. 64 KiB) and require a regular file.
examples/snapshot.rs: reject SIZE with zero or absurdly large dimensions.
